TEAM_VIEWS.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: Shared views: the same filter for a whole team, with its own columns, sort order and live count.
TEAM_VIEWS.EMPTY: No team views yet. Create one and pick the teams that should see it.

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.TEAMS_HINT: Leave every team unchecked to show the view to the whole account.

API.SAVE_ERROR: The view could not be saved
API.DELETE_ERROR: The view could not be removed

SLA.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: Targets for first response, next response and resolution, by priority, with a business-hours calendar. The first active policy whose conditions match a conversation applies.
SLA.EMPTY: No SLA policy yet. Create the first one and the SLA starts running on new conversations.
SLA.NO_SLA: No SLA applies to this conversation

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.WARNING_RATIO: Warn when % of the target is left
FORM.TARGETS_HINT: Leave a cell empty to skip that metric. Priorities without a value fall back to Default.
FORM.CONDITIONS_HINT: No conditions means every conversation. Policies are checked in order; the first match wins.

API.SAVE_ERROR: The policy could not be saved
API.DELETE_ERROR: The policy could not be removed

DELETE.CONFIRM: Delete the policy "{name}"? Conversations lose their SLA.

WORKSPACE.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: What each team sees: menu, list layout and columns, ticket fields, side panels, apps and macros. The account default applies to every team; a team configuration overrides it.
WORKSPACE.FIELDS_HINT: Assignee, team and priority come together; the other fields are custom attributes of the conversation.

API.SAVE_ERROR: The workspace could not be saved

SUBMIT_AS.ERROR: The message was sent, but the status could not be changed

AGENT_ROLES.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: Light agents read the conversations of their teams and inboxes and only write private notes. Administrators are always full.

API.SAVE_ERROR: The role could not be saved

CALENDARS.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: Hours per weekday and holidays. An SLA policy that points to a calendar only counts time inside these hours.
CALENDARS.EMPTY: No calendar yet. Without one, SLA targets run around the clock.

API.SAVE_ERROR: The calendar could not be saved
API.DELETE_ERROR: The calendar could not be removed

DELETE.CONFIRM: Delete the calendar "{name}"? Policies using it switch to the wall clock.

AGENT_STATUS.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: What an agent handles right now: everything, only chat, only tickets, or away. Agents pick it in the availability menu; automatic assignment only hands out conversations from the inboxes the status serves.
AGENT_STATUS.EMPTY: No custom status yet. Create statuses like Available, Chat only, Tickets only and Away.

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.CAPACITY_HINT: How many conversations automatic distribution hands over at once in this status. Blank means no limit; zero takes the agent out of that queue. Email inboxes count as tickets, everything else as chat, and only what is being handled counts.

API.SAVE_ERROR: The status could not be saved
API.DELETE_ERROR: The status could not be removed

DELETE.CONFIRM: Delete the status "{name}"? Its history is removed too.

LOAD.TITLE: Load right now
LOAD.DESCRIPTION: Conversations being handled right now, per queue, against the limit of each agent's current status.
LOAD.EMPTY: Nobody is handling anything right now.

TICKET_STATUS.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: The statuses your operation uses, as in Zendesk. Each maps to one of the four StayDesk statuses (open, pending, snoozed, resolved); filters, views and automations see it through the "Ticket status" attribute.
TICKET_STATUS.EMPTY: No custom statuses. Without a catalog, agents use the four default statuses.

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.BASE_STATUS_HINT: When the base status changes another way (automation, bot, auto resolve), the conversation gets the default status of that base.

DELETE.CONFIRM: Delete the status "{name}"? Conversations using it will show the default of the base status.
